name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump claims U.S. adults will get a $5k ‘dividend’ if Republicans win the midterms
changes.summary: During his speech at the Republican midterm convention, President Donald Trump announced that every adult U.S. citizen would receive a $5,000 “dividend” if Republican won the midterm elections in November, but said it must be spent in the U.S.

changes.title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
changes.summary: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him. (Image credit: Kent Nishimura).

changes.title: Trump’s Census Overhaul Would Exclude Some Immigrants and Remove Questions on Race
changes.summary: The proposals for 2030 are among significant changes that would upend a process for helping allot congressional seats and shape policies that address disparities.

changes.title: Fetterman Has a Surprise Cameo at Trump’s Convention
changes.summary: Senator John Fetterman, who has become alienated from his own party, appeared in a short video filmed in front of a steel mill, saying he is “always going to reject the extremes in socialism.”.

changes.title: Trump escalates Canada trade war by banning some imports
changes.summary: After Canada's retaliatory tariffs against the U.S. took effect on Tuesday, the Trump administration moved to ban imports of certain Canadian motorcycles, dairy products and alcohol. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes has more.

changes.title: Trump gave $45,000 gift to Natalie Harp, 2 other aides
changes.summary: A White House spokesperson said in a statement on Wednesday that Mr. Trump "has a longstanding practice of giving Christmas gifts to people in his orbit.".

changes.title: President Trump delivers remarks at the Republican midterm convention
changes.summary: Watch live coverage as President Trump delivers the keynote address as the first Republican midterm convention kicks off in Dallas.

changes.title: Trump admin fires prosecutor in dropped case against politically linked billionaire
changes.summary: A federal prosecutor who had been assigned to the now-defunct case against a politically-linked Indian billionaire has been fired by the Trump administration, two people familiar with the firing tell NBC News.

changes.title: Trump says oil prices will come down after midterm elections
changes.summary: President Donald Trump, in an exchange with reporters before traveling to Dallas for the midterm Republican convention, added that he believes Iran will finally relent after the pivotal elections are held in the U.S.

changes.title: Democrats say Trump's 'bizarre' convention is a distraction from his faltering presidency
changes.summary: "This bizarre Republican midterm convention here can't paper over the fact that Republicans have done nothing to earn your vote," Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, a potential 2028 presidential contender, said Wednesday morning.
